title: Commit package-lock.json and use npm ci
body:
## Goal
Run `npm install` to generate `package-lock.json` and commit it so installs are reproducible.

## Acceptance criteria
- `package-lock.json` is committed
- `npm ci && npm test` passes
- `npm run typecheck && npm test` pass

title: Add ESLint flat config with typescript-eslint
body:
## Goal
Add `eslint.config.js` using `typescript-eslint` recommended-type-checked rules and an `npm run lint` script. Fix any findings.

## Acceptance criteria
- `npm run lint` passes with zero errors
- Config ignores `dist/`
- `npm run typecheck && npm test` pass

title: Add paginate() async iterator for collections
body:

title: Retry with exponential backoff on 429 and 5xx
body:

## Acceptance criteria

- `npm run typecheck && npm test` pass

title: Request timeout via AbortSignal
body:
